novelty.justification: The artifact states "The three perspective sections are blank" and "there are no hypotheses to synthesize," so it provides no core method to compare against the Solution Space. It cannot be mapped to entries such as R29 or R24 because it proposes nothing.
novelty.rubric: Existing: the idea's core method is already clearly present or solved in the Solution Space; only tiny parameter / test-case changes.
novelty.differentiation: None; the artifact contains no proposed method, so no differentiation from any Solution Space entry can be identified.

feasibility.justification: The artifact says "Please provide the actual hypotheses" and "The three perspective sections are blank," meaning there is no implementable design, engineering plan, or evaluation pipeline. It is not executable as a research study in its current form.
feasibility.rubric: Theoretically infeasible / compute catastrophe: NP-hard-scale computation, must dynamically reproduce extremely complex system-level vulnerability environments, or depends on unavailable closed-source model internal weights; not doable by a single person.

clarity.justification: The prose is grammatically clear but substantively empty: it only repeats that "the three perspective sections are blank" and "there are no hypotheses to synthesize." The What/Why/How of a research idea are entirely missing.
clarity.rubric: Vague concept: full of empty buzzwords; problem undefined; method only gives a high-level direction with little substance.
